Agent Name: WebServing_Expert  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The WebServing_Expert incorrectly identified the last line of the rhyme under the flavor name on the headstone visible in the background of the photo of Dastardly Mash as "So it may not be beaucoup too late to save Crème Brulee from beyond the grave." This was an error because the actual last line of the rhyme under the flavor name on the headstone visible in the background is "So we had to let it die," which corresponds to a different headstone. The WebServing_Expert failed to accurately identify the correct headstone visible in the background of the Dastardly Mash photo and consequently provided an incorrect answer. This error was not corrected by subsequent agents, leading to an incorrect solution to the problem.
